name: unwritten-pipe-context
text:
The estimated size of the suffix a compaction keeps is available to any caller, not to the summarizer alone.

`crates/context/src/lib.rs` decides where the kept suffix begins. `steps` estimates the tokens of every ordinary step whose first request lies at or after a sequence number, and `first_kept` picks the first of those steps to keep. `summarize` then sums the estimates of the kept steps inline, once, to report the size the active context has after the cut. A caller that wants that number before it decides to compact, or for a report of what a compaction saved, folds the events a second time itself.

Add `pub fn kept_tokens(events: &[Event], first_kept_seq: u64) -> u64` to that module, returning the sum of the estimates `steps` gives for the steps at or after `first_kept_seq`, and have `summarize` take its `kept` from it. The sum over no step is 0. Add a unit test for a slice with no event, for a cut that keeps every step, and for a cut that keeps the newest step alone.

The documents under docs/ describe the behavior. Each sentence below belongs in the document named before it, in the same words:
- docs/compaction.md: the estimated size of the kept suffix is the sum of the estimates of the steps at or after the cut, so a caller can read what a compaction leaves without folding the events again.

checks/run.sh runs the checks this task is judged on: scripts/loc.sh, the first line on the pipe of the context test reporter, the tests of foe-context, and clippy with warnings denied on the same crates.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
